item.title: Kokorone=Pendulum!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Clochette
  • 発売日: 2019-07-26
  • スコア: 7.49/10 (85 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ココロネ=ペンデュラム！
  • 英語名: Kokorone=Pendulum!

别名

  • Korolum

あらすじ

Around 30 years ago, superpowers known as ‘magia’ started appearing in Japan. Soujirou recently gained the ability to read other people’s minds. Normally these powers would awaken in people over the course of a few days, but for him, it took a full two years. Furthermore, he isn’t able to control his ability well and it gives him headaches from time to time. With the intention of getting rid of it, he decided to enroll in Shizuka-no-Umi Academy in Saema, a leading academic research city where magia users (saucers) gathered.

item.title: Haruru Minamo ni!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Clochette
  • 発売日: 2017-03-24
  • スコア: 7.640000000000001/10 (170 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はるるみなもに!
  • 英語名: Haruru Minamo ni!

别名

  • Harumina

あらすじ

The seaside town of Tamatsue is surrounded by mountains on three sides. Even though it is undergoing modernization via re-development of the coastal area, there is still a feel of a small town in the mountain side. There are two shrines in the town, dedicated to the ‘god of the mountains’ and the ‘god of the sea’, but while the former has a ‘living goddess’ who they are proud of, there is no enshrined deity for the latter. Thus, they invited a new god to take its place. However, the ‘living goddess’ who appeared was rather useless and couldn’t fulfill the roles required of her!

item.title: Koko kara Natsu no Innocence!
item.description:

  • 発売日: 2015-11-27

  • 日本語名: ここから夏のイノセンス！
  • 英語名: Koko kara Natsu no Innocence!

别名

  • Kokonatsu

あらすじ

Not so long ago, as the urban areas progressed in their development towards being an information society, there were many places in the mountainous area which kept the same olden feeling. Yoshitsugu was a visitor from 100 years in the future who came to the mountain village Akio-mura. He had been labelled as a failure in the ultra-competitive society in the future, so it was unknown how he was able to travel to the past, an opportunity open only to those with high social positions.

item.title: Kamikaze ☆ Explorer!
item.description:

  • 英語名: Kamikaze ☆ Explorer!

别名

  • 神风探索者

あらすじ

In the near future, the living areas for humans reduce due to climate and terrain changes. As if in unison, some of the younger generation develop special powers called Metis. There are many types of Metis, from magic barriers to being able to breathe under water. Suminoe Gakuen was constructed to train and develop those students with Metis. Keiji doesn’t have any powers, but he was scouted by an agent from the school and ends up attending the school. He is then recruited into Argonaut, a club for helping people with their problems. One day, they hear about a strange rumour about the recently developed Kamigase-shi…

别名

  • あまみそ

あらすじ

Takahisa lives on Misora-jima with Kanna, a goddess who came to his house when he was a child and started living with him. He also has an imouto Miyu who is a gravure idol and is often away from home. That doesn’t mean things are quiet though, since Miyu’s best friend Serika idolizes Kanna and often causes a big ruckus. One day Serika comes in with big news: there’s a miko coming to the island!

item.title: Suzunone Seven!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Clochette
  • 発売日: 2009-01-30
  • スコア: 7.17/10 (71 人評価)
  • 日本語名: スズノネセブン！
  • 英語名: Suzunone Seven!

别名

  • Suzunone7

あらすじ

Suzunone Magic Academy is a prestigious educational and research establishment where magic meets science. Established shortly after magic has been first discovered, it has departments dedicated both to the study of magic itself, and to the engineering of devices that use magic.

Kido Yukimura is a student in the Academy’s engineering division. He cannot use magic, and his unorthodox engineering approach has landed him in Suzunone Trial, a special training camp where the worst seven students from the academy are chosen every year. Each of those students is given a special personal assignment they have to pass in order to avoid getting expelled, and the assignment Yukimura gets is to “fulfill someone’s wish using magic”, which, given his inability to use magic, is challenging to say the least. How will he get out this predicament? And whose wish will he choose to fulfill?

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • スコア: 7.470000000000001/10 (61 人評価)
  • 日本語名: かみぱに！
  • 英語名: Kamipani!

あらすじ

Tomoyuki has moved to his hometown in the country and started living alone. He meets his childhood friends, Megumi, Nonoka, and Amane, and enjoys his life there.

But one day, a girl suddenly comes to his house. She calls herself god, and begins to live at his house. He doesn’t know what’s going on…?

Something new now starts at his good old hometown…
